description: This file defines helper functions for extracting resources from device and endpoint objects in the Zilker SDK. It provides function prototypes for retrieving resources as strings, booleans, and floats, along with licensing and project-specific comments.

methods.name: extractDeviceResource
methods.description: Extracts a specified resource from a device object, returning a copy of its value or the provided default.

methods.name: extractEndpointResource
methods.description: Extracts a specified resource from an endpoint object, returning a copy of its value or the provided default.

methods.name: extractEndpointResourceAsBool
methods.description: Extracts a specified resource from an endpoint object as a boolean value, returning a default if not found.

methods.name: extractEndpointResourceAsFloat
methods.description: Extracts a specified resource from an endpoint object as a float value, returning a default if not found.
